verdictEs: Raidbots si necesitas simular tu character específico — top gear, stat weights con tu gear actual, Droptimizer contra un raid. Bloodmallet si solo quieres respuesta rápida tipo 'qué trinket del Vault elijo' sin tocar tu profile — charts pre-computados por spec.
verdictEn: Raidbots if you need to simulate your specific character — top gear, stat weights with your current gear, Droptimizer against a raid. Bloodmallet if you just want a quick 'which Vault trinket do I pick' answer without touching your profile — pre-computed per-spec charts.

useCases.labelEs: Decidir qué pieza del Vault de esta semana es mejor
useCases.labelEn: Decide which Vault piece this week is best
useCases.reasonEs: Bloodmallet tiene charts pre-computados de trinkets ranked por spec. Abres el page, ves el ranking, eliges — 30 segundos. Raidbots requiere subir tu profile y correr sim — overkill cuando solo necesitas un quick check.
useCases.reasonEn: Bloodmallet has pre-computed trinket charts ranked per spec. Open the page, see the ranking, pick — 30 seconds. Raidbots requires uploading your profile and running a sim — overkill when you just need a quick check.

useCases.labelEs: Calcular stat weights con tu gear y talents actuales
useCases.labelEn: Calculate stat weights with your current gear and talents
useCases.reasonEs: Raidbots simula tu character específico con tu setup actual. Stat weights resulting reflejan diminishing returns en tu gear level específico — different than el generic stat weight de Bloodmallet.
useCases.reasonEn: Raidbots simulates your specific character with your current setup. Resulting stat weights reflect diminishing returns at your specific gear level — different than Bloodmallet's generic stat weight.

useCases.labelEs: Droptimizer: comparar todos los upgrades posibles de un raid
useCases.labelEn: Droptimizer: compare all possible upgrades from a raid
useCases.reasonEs: Raidbots Droptimizer simula tu char vs cada item dropeable del raid y te ranking exactamente qué te bueffa más. Bloodmallet no tiene este tool — sus charts son aggregate, no character-specific.
useCases.reasonEn: Raidbots Droptimizer simulates your char against each dropable item from the raid and ranks exactly what buffs you most. Bloodmallet doesn't have this tool — its charts are aggregate, not character-specific.

useCases.labelEs: Comparar tier set bonuses entre dos specs
useCases.labelEn: Compare tier set bonuses between two specs
useCases.reasonEs: Bloodmallet tiene charts por spec con tier sets ranked desde 2-set, 4-set, embellishments y combinations. Useful para players multi-spec que evalúan switch. Raidbots simula uno por vez — más lento para comparación cross-spec.
useCases.reasonEn: Bloodmallet has per-spec charts with tier sets ranked from 2-set, 4-set, embellishments, and combinations. Useful for multi-spec players evaluating switches. Raidbots simulates one at a time — slower for cross-spec comparison.

useCases.labelEs: Setup inicial de season sin profile listo en SimC
useCases.labelEn: Initial season setup without a ready SimC profile
useCases.reasonEs: Bloodmallet no requiere upload — abres el web y ves rankings inmediatamente. Raidbots requiere export SimC string desde el game y paste. Para player que recién arranca season, Bloodmallet es lower friction.
useCases.reasonEn: Bloodmallet requires no upload — open the web and see rankings immediately. Raidbots requires SimC string export from the game and paste. For a player just starting the season, Bloodmallet is lower friction.
